thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx/error rate observed on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Elevated prefix miss ratio and KV fetch latency spike. Paging @mike_oncall — please acknowledge.

mike_oncall: oncall here, seeing the page. pulling up dashboards.

sara_sre: same — inference pool tail latency + CPU on the q4-gpu nodes. Prefix miss rate for tenant acme-inc jumped ~x10 around 12:20 PDT. Looks like hot-cardinality causing cache thrash.

mike_oncall: any quick live mitigations we can run? We should prioritize keeping correctness and minimizing customer-facing errors.

ben_prodeng: options (quick): 1) tenant-level rate cap, 2) disable prefetch for tenant, 3) temporary cache-bypass for correctness (will add backend load), 4) fallback routing to smaller model variant. I vote for (1)+(2) first to stabilize.

mike_oncall: agree. starting with tenant rate limit + disable prefetch. If correctness anomalies persist, enable cache-bypass.

mike_oncall: running: `trafficctl rate set --tenant acme-inc --limit 8rps`
deploy-bot: trafficctl job queued -> success (job id: 0x7f9d). Changes propagating to edge (~15s).

ben_prodeng: pushing prefetch toggle for acme-inc now.
deploy-bot: config update applied (cfg-2026-03-17-1). Prefetch disabled for tenant acme-inc.

ryan_runtime: telemetry update: prefix miss ratio dropping, KV backend p95 latency down from ~1.2s -> ~300ms in last 90s. Overall request error rate trending down but still noisy.

cs_lead: customer impact: acme-inc reported degraded responses starting ~12:20. Support notified; we've told them we're applying rate limits to stabilize. No customer data loss reported, some requests may be delayed or rejected while limit holds.

mike_oncall: seeing a handful of correctness anomalies where cached prefixes returned stale keys (risk of wrong completions). To avoid incorrect outputs, I'm going to enable cache-bypass-for-correctness for acme-inc — accept backend cost for correctness.

ben_prodeng: executing: `cachectl bypass set --tenant acme-inc --mode correctness`
deploy-bot: bypass applied at routing layer (bypass-330). Note: this will make requests hit KV each time; watch backend error/cost.

sara_sre: monitoring KV backend now. If backend error rate exceeds 3% or latency/cost becomes unsustainable, we'll revert bypass and instead spin up dedicated fetchers / scale KV read path.

mike_oncall: summary for handoff: mitigations in effect — tenant rate-limit 8rps, prefetch disabled, cache-bypass-for-correctness enabled. Incident tagged INC-2026-03-17-01. Handoff to ryan_runtime in 30m. I'll update status page and ops channel.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-17-01 acknowledged by mike_oncall at 2790123456. Next scheduled update 12:55 PDT.

cs_lead: I'll send customer update note now and include expected stabilization steps + ETA. :email:

ryan_runtime: taking over monitoring. will escalate to infra if KV errors spike. ping me in #eng-sre if anyone sees unexplained 5xx after rollback.

mike_oncall: thanks team — marking active mitigations in the incident board. will add postmortem checklist: root-cause perf + cache eviction strategy + rate-limit thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploys/changes during thread: trafficctl(0x7f9d) cfg-2026-03-17-1 bypass-330.
